method: Private original numerical functions, no source artwork or scripts published

results.scope: Original private numerical functions versus independent HTML equations: every declared single-control level with other controls at default, 101 spatial samples and four declared times for animated models. All 25 two-state tuples, 28 radial tuples, 36 nonnegative angular tuples and eight dispersion presets additionally included. Continuous simultaneous slider combinations are not exhausted.
